title: SteerSpec Realm Manifest Schema
description: Schema for realm.json manifest files. Hand-maintained axiom.

language.description: The Realm's natural language as a BCP 47 tag (RLMMNFST-006). Top-level Realms only (RLM-022).

standards.description: External standards the Realm cites (STDREF-001). The uniqueness of each id is checked by lint (STDREF-003).

realm.description: The Standard Realm this reference links to, a dependency of the Realm tree (STDREF-017). Its version must equal that Realm's edition (STDREF-018), checked by lint.

profile.description: The claimed profile of the linked Standard Realm, allowed only with realm (STDREF-019) and declared by that Realm (STDREF-027), checked by lint.

kind.description: The Realm's kind (RLMMNFST-008). Absent means a code Realm (RLMMNFST-009).

license.description: SPDX license identifier of the Realm's content (RLMMNFST-010). Required in a Standard Realm (STDRLM-003), checked by lint.

attribution.description: Attribution of the Realm's content (RLMMNFST-011). Required in a Standard Realm (STDRLM-015), checked by lint.

edition.description: The edition of the standard a Standard Realm transcribes (STDRLM-002).

profiles.description: Profile names a Standard Realm's Rules may declare, in order (STDRLM-004).

contributors.description: Contributors of the Realm (CTRB-004). The provider list (CTRB-002), unique ids, their use in added_by (CTRB-005) and sub-realm inheritance (CTRB-006) are checked by lint.

github_id.description: Numeric GitHub user ID, for `github` contributors (CTRB-008).

source.description: Fetch location for this dependency (e.g. github://owner/repo@version/path)

items.description: Single directory name satisfying the realm-id segment grammar.

sub_realms.description: Subdirectory names of child Realms (RLM-010). Null or absent if none.

rule_identifier_format.description: Overrides of the RLIFRMT defaults (RLMMNFST-004). Every field is optional and falls back to its default. For a top-level Realm, null keeps all defaults; for a sub-realm, null means the parent's format applies (RLM-015). Affects rendering only (RLIFRMT-008).

euid_position.description: Position of the Entity Unique Identifier (RLIFRMT-003); the Rule Set Unique Number takes the opposing position (RLIFRMT-004).

id_splitter.description: Separator between the Entity Unique Identifier and the Rule Set Unique Number (RLIFRMT-005).

notes.description: Realm Notes (RLMMNFST-012, NTE-029). A `ref` is required on an `exclusion` Note (NTE-034) and kept when the exclusion is withdrawn by retyping it to `reference` (NTE-035); no other Realm Note has one. These and sequential identifiers (NTE-030) are checked by lint.

ref.description: The excluded clause, `<id>:<clause>`. Required on an `exclusion` (NTE-034), and kept on the `reference` an exclusion becomes when withdrawn (NTE-035).

hash.description: Blake3 hash of the manifest without its `hash` field (RLMMNFST-013), recomputed on every change (RLMMNFST-014).
